declaration.negotiation_history_statement: Whitcombe Reyes LLP and Brightline reached the settlement through arm’s-length negotiations. Class relief and attorneys’ fees were addressed in the same negotiation process; fees were not first discussed only after class relief was agreed. This statement does not disclose confidential offers or mediation communications. The agreement provides a $30 million fund for automatic payments to identified class members, with no claims process. The $2.5 million fee provision is subject to court approval, Brightline has not agreed to refrain from opposing the fee request, and any fees not awarded will benefit the class rather than revert to Brightline. Our firm’s compensation is fixed regardless of the settlement or fee award; any awarded fee is payable to the consumer-protection foundation, not the firm. In our judgment, the direct recovery is fair in light of the risks of certification and trial and the time litigation would require.
